description: A job request set contains job requests (currently: queue requests and resource requests)
valid for a specific scope of parallel tasks (global, master, slaves).
Sequential jobs can have a single job request set, the global one.
Parallel jobs can have up to 3 request sets, global requests, requests for the master task,
None of them must exist, every one can exist, depending on requests

attributes.name: hard_resource_list
description: List of hard resource requests, from qsub -l name=value request.

attributes.name: soft_resource_list
description: List of soft resource requests, from qsub -soft -l name=value request.

attributes.name: hard_queue_list
description: List of hard queue requests, from qsub -q dest_identifier request.

attributes.name: soft_queue_list
description: List of soft queue requests, from qsub -soft -q dest_identifier request.

attributes.name: allocation_rule
description: Overwrites the allocation rule of the parallel environment for this scope.

attributes.name: ignore_slave_requests_on_master_host
attributes.summary: Ignore Slave Requests on Master Host
description: Overwrites the ignore_slave_requests_on_master_host option of the parallel environment for this scope.
